advantages.0.title: Ingen bränning eller sveda
advantages.0.desc: Scrape agitator continuously moves milk film across heated surface for uniform khoya colour.
advantages.1.title: Faster Batch Completion
advantages.1.desc: Steam-jacketed pan with efficient heat transfer reduces khoya making time vs. open-fire methods.
advantages.2.title: Consistent Khoya Texture
advantages.2.desc: Programmable heating and agitation cycles deliver repeatable semi-solid consistency every batch.
advantages.3.title: Wide Capacity Range
advantages.3.desc: Pan sizes from 50 L for mithai shops to 1,000 L for commercial sweet manufacturing units.
advantages.4.title: Hygienic SS Construction
advantages.4.desc: SS304/316 pan with mirror polish finish meets food safety standards for direct milk contact.
advantages.5.title: Lower Fuel Consumption
advantages.5.desc: Insulated jacket and efficient steam utilization cut energy cost vs. traditional kadais.
how.0.title: Milk Charging
how.0.desc: Fresh milk loaded into the open evaporating pan at the start of each khoya batch.
how.1.title: Evaporation Under Heat
how.1.desc: Steam jacket supplies heat; milk volume reduces progressively as water evaporates.
how.2.title: Continuous Scraping
how.2.desc: Scrape agitator moves milk film across heated surface to prevent burn-on and scorching.
how.3.title: Khoya Consistency Reached
how.3.desc: Milk thickens to semi-solid khoya at programmed endpoint based on time or visual consistency.
how.4.title: Urladdning & Kylning
how.4.desc: Khoya discharged onto cooling tray; pan cleaned and prepared for next batch.

tagline: Rostfritt stål khoya (mawa) tillverkningsmaskin med ångmantlad panna, skrapomrörare och automatisk temperaturkontroll.
overview.p0: Gausin Khoya Making Machine är konstruerad för pålitlig, hygienisk prestanda i krävande industriella miljöer.
overview.p1: Varje enhet är specialdesignad för din kapacitet, produktegenskaper och krav på anläggningslayout med SS 304/316L kontaktytor, validerad processdesign och fullständig dokumentation.
overview.p2: Gausin tillhandahåller komplett ingenjörsstöd från processdesign och tillverkning till installation, driftsättning och eftermarknadsservice.
